about.heading: whoami
paragraphs: Kevin White. By day, a Software Engineering Manager in local government digital, where the work is making public services less annoying to use. By night, much the same thing, only for problems nobody asked me to solve.
I build a lot with AI. My assistant, **KB-AI**, writes most of the code, all of the PDFs and, frankly, the better half of my jokes. I mostly supply the opinions and the typos.

tunes.heading: cat tunesday.txt
paragraphs: Every week a group of friends picks songs to a theme. Every week an AI marks them, without mercy and with footnotes. Past winners include the Beatles. Past losers include basic arithmetic.
tunes.note: My own picks once won the *Copied the AI's Homework* award. I stand by them. Nobody else does.

cards.title: #TunesDay reviews
cards.text: The weekly snarky review site. Grades, awards, and the occasional pointed remark about release dates.

cards.title: That logo up there
cards.text: Generated frame by frame in Python. Stone collides, stone crumbles, stone becomes chrome. Took longer than it should. Plays once, because some of us have taste.

cards.title: AI experiments
cards.text: KB-AI: an assistant that reads, writes, emails and occasionally gets corrected. Most of what's on this page started as "can it do that?" and ended as "why did I let it do that?"

cards.title: Fantasy football analytics
cards.text: Scouting reports, gameplans and a weekly fanzine for a long-running online fantasy American football league. More spreadsheets than any hobby needs. The analytics are excellent. The win record is a separate matter.
